page.content:
216 BCE encirclement, Rome's worst field defeat.

How Battle of Cannae connects

  • Character: Hannibal — Hannibal destroyed the Roman army at Cannae.
  • Event: Punic Wars — Cannae was the nadir of the Second Punic War.

What is Battle of Cannae?

At Cannae, Hannibal destroyed a double consular army. The Republic refused peace, raised new legions, and survived — the trauma behind later fear of one-man command.

Key threads lead to Hannibal and Punic Wars.
